page.overview:
Who is Perfect Pace?

Perfect Pace is a male background Earth pony with a blue coat, bright orange mane and tail, golden brown eyes, and a cutie mark of an hourglass. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise and other media.__TOC__

Perfect Pace has the same design, eye color, and accessory design as "Emerald Beacon", the same mane style, eye color, cutie mark, and accessory design as "Infinity", the same tail style, eye color, cutie mark, and accessory design as "Raggedy Doctor", the same tail style, eye color, and cutie mark as "The Tenth Doctor / Doctor Whooves #3", the same tail style, coat and sometimes eye colors, and sometimes cutie mark as Royal Pin, the same tail style and coat color as Madden, the same tail style and eye color as "Star Gazer", "Star Bright", and S04E19 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, the same tail style and sometimes eye color as Starry Eyes, the same eye color and sometimes tail style as "Earl Grey", and the same tail style as Compass Star, "Ponet", "Sightseer", "Poppycock", S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #4, and S04E17 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4.

He first appears in The Best Night Ever as a guest at the Grand Galloping Gala. He is one of several chorus singers in At the Gala, during which he smiles at Fluttershy.

In Sweet and Elite, Perfect Pace appears several times during Becoming Popular (The Pony Everypony Should Know) and at the Canterlot Garden Party. He appears as a judge for the dessert competition at the end of MMMystery on the Friendship Express (with a different cutie mark), and he attends both wedding ceremonies as well as the reception in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2.
